source_observations: The stamped F4TE-10239-AC photographs show one broad curved web, several recessed panels, perimeter and radial ribs, and an asymmetric narrower extension.
The photographed casting has rounded transitions and axial depth rather than two circular wire-like supports.

The four existing model engine seats are retained; the photographed individual bores cannot be matched confidently to those seats from the available perspective views.
The fork/arm passes above the Thermactor body in the model. Its installed direction and center distances remain unmeasured.
